The source URLs point directly to versioned release assets, not mutable branches, and the checksums are present and valid. No scripts or commands are present in this file, and there is no indication of data exfiltration, remote code execution, or supply-chain tampering.

This file only contains metadata and does not execute any code. It does not reference or invoke any external scripts, and all sources are pinned to a specific release. The use of a prebuilt binary (`swiftdl-bin`) is common in AUR for software not easily built from source, and the transparency of the source and checksums supports auditability.
